time_domains.arrival_vio_rpe_tracking_map: Gazebo simulated source stamps; wall time is reported separately
time_domains.resource_cpu_memory: wall monotonic samples and cgroup cumulative counters
time_domains.faults: record trigger, source/receipt times, bridge/PX4 transitions, and terminal readback in their native clocks without merging domains

reference_points.px4_base_to_imu_lever_arm: applied only in the bridge conversion and body-envelope geometry; do not add it to truth a second time

segments.arrival: navigation goal source stamp through native goal completion; independent joint position/yaw dwell must occur within this interval
segments.goal_motion: goal source stamp through native goal completion
segments.active_hold: native goal completion through the runner-recorded requested simulated hold duration
segments.landing: active hold end through the first independent LANDED bridge sample
segments.full_task: prestream alignment start through independent LANDED sample
segments.fault: injection acknowledgement through stable landed/disarmed/control-disabled terminal state; preserve every event timestamp

arrival_position_yaw_dwell.method: One fixed scale-one prestream SE(3); compare the same IMU reference point; simultaneously satisfy position and yaw on contiguous simulation source time; no interpolation credit for dwell.

raw_vio_absolute_error.method: N01 absolute error under the same fixed prestream alignment; show each segment and source-gap support; no segment fit.

raw_vio_rpe_10s.method: N01 relative-pose calculation at exact 10 simulated-second intervals; report candidate, supported, and rejected pair counts. User#500 removes the translation numeric rejection limit; preserve measured translation, supported/rejected pair coverage, and existing rotation comparison.

raw_vio_velocity_error.method: Raw VINS world-frame velocity versus centered 0.2 simulated-second truth IMU velocity; no extrapolation; never interpret these as commanded-speed caps.

raw_map_surface_geometry.method: Use one identity-bound snapshot containing the raw occupancy array and separate inflated mask. Compare occupied voxel centers with the injected SDF surface offline, and report support per observed face; unobserved faces remain explicitly unsupported and are not inferred from missing points. Snapshot identity, source-time coverage, array shape/order and hashes are required. Live point queries remain optional diagnostics and are not repeatedly required when the raw/inflated snapshot already provides the relevant map evidence. User#508: surface-center error is diagnostic without a numeric rejection limit; retain finite observed values and identity/source support. Actual body clearance and classification thresholds are unchanged.

raw_map_classification.method: Report visible-free, surface, and truth-occluded ROI counts separately. Unknown remains its own class. This is a diagnostic semantic check, not a raw-known-free flight gate.

native_behavior.source: current EGO upstream parameter; retain the native behavior and do not duplicate it as a project-local gate

map_source_and_update_age.method: Keep source, fusion/update, response/receipt stamps separate; report maximum samples and gaps. These offline candidate values do not trigger launch, cancellation, or landing.

ego_tracking_error.method: User#520 removes the minimum body-clearance numeric comparison. Keep finite actual body/spline/interval clearance measurements, run/source identities, complete 4ms physics/command pairing and zero prohibited contact. dynamic_replanning.method: User#520 removes the minimum body-clearance numeric comparison. fault_exit_to_terminal_px4_state.method: Derive detection and terminal timing from native mechanisms and one current-version calibration per unsupported class; do not substitute a request to stop or a bridge LAND command for independent PX4 state readback.
fault_exit_to_terminal_px4_state.scope_note: Not required for current N10.3 normal-navigation calibration. This exclusion does not qualify fault response or erase failures.

resource_and_queue_behavior.capacity_source: identity-bound run cgroup counters and same-workspace host capacity observation; freeze both at N10.7
resource_and_queue_behavior.unknown_queue_capacity_policy: Report VINS estimator queue capacity as unknown because upstream source is unbounded; do not infer a cap from observed high-water. N16 separately evaluates 600 simulated seconds for sustained growth.
resource_and_queue_behavior.method: Bind CPU and memory comparison limits to cgroup quota or host capacity. Require zero cgroup throttling/OOM and complete one-second observation with no gap over two sample periods. Check finite mapping depth against its configured cap; report drops alongside map freshness and realized clearance. For VINS, record current-depth trend and process high-water but keep capacity explicitly unknown. RTF, CPU, memory, PID, and queue values are offline-only; no runtime refusal is added. N16 remains the separate 600 simulated-second duration test. Revision9 uses native pending feature work and source horizons. Raw IMU/feature current counts, slopes and process high-water remain diagnostics. Lag budget0.2s reserves half the native0.4s EGO input timeout; at30Hz stereo/stride2 processing this permits at most2 waiting features behind the current item. Missing native fields are INSUFFICIENT; stale post-consumption IMU or horizon/backlog violations FAIL. Offline only.

observer_identity_binding.method: Require run_id, runtime-contract SHA-256, goal_id, epoch and map_id on each observer report; require the sensor receipt ledger to match decompressed MCAP topic/source-stamp/frame keys. This checks evidence linkage only and is not system acceptance or runtime control. Missing or divergent identity is INSUFFICIENT.

sensor_streams.topic_source: Resolve image0_topic, image1_topic and imu_topic from config/components/localization/vins_sim.json and record the effective launch-resolved names.
sensor_streams.payload_capture: tools/diagnostics/record_n10_sensor_streams.py writes rosbag2 MCAP with lossless zstd_fast chunk compression and a separate receipt-monotonic JSONL ledger; tools/debug_truth/evaluate_n10_sensor_capture.py matches every decompressed topic/source-stamp/frame key. Recorder errors never block, cancel or land the task; if payload capture is incomplete, retain receipt metadata and classify visual-content diagnosis as INSUFFICIENT.
sensor_streams.coverage: Record from prestream through verified safe terminal plus the resource observer's 3 s closeout window; record per-stream count, gaps, out-of-order stamps, and recorder coverage.

debug_truth.source: Gazebo /debug_truth/base_odometry poses plus optional /debug_truth/model_kinematics instantaneous physics ledger; both outside the production control graph.
required_evidence: identity/hash-bound instantaneous model-origin world velocities for every endpoint used by the model interval bound
debug_truth.coverage_rule: Only exact consecutive solver-state capture may claim solver-state coverage; otherwise report sampled result or INSUFFICIENT.

map_and_planner.snapshot: Prefer one identity-bound GetOccupancySnapshot response containing raw and inflated arrays plus source/fusion stamps, frame, epoch and map_id.
map_and_planner.point_queries: Persist each request/response, query type and radius request/echo; raw occupancy and official planning occupancy verdicts retain their own semantics. Do not require separate RPCs to share an identical timestamp.
map_and_planner.replanning: Record obstacle create/move request and ACK, raw/inflated observation, active trajectory identity/status, map update and PositionCommand source stamps, and actual truth path.

resource_and_queue.sampling: Wall-monotonic sample times with paired sim time; use the shared observer and preserve its complete coverage interval.
resource_and_queue.missing_data: INSUFFICIENT; never feed resource or recorder state into takeoff, cancellation, pause or landing control.

calibration_observation_contract.fault_closeout: For a fault-calibration run, record trigger ACK, last valid trajectory, EGO/navigation/bridge/PX4 state transitions and an independent landed/disarmed/control-disabled/zero-control terminal window. A LAND request or an emergency closeout is not native fault-to-terminal success.
calibration_observation_contract.missing_or_invalid_evidence: INSUFFICIENT; evidence capture does not alter runtime behavior.
